por_que: Segunda tanda: afinado sobre las 25 elegidas de la primera. Regla aprendida: el atrezo inventado dice el título en un objeto; nada de gags sueltos ni cosas que descifrar. Una o dos por título del paquete, con los fallos corregidos (especie de la tortuga rusa, caras pequeñas, pala sin doblar).
prefijo_1311: Create a YouTube thumbnail, 16:9 landscape, everything important in the central area. Attached image 1 is the man: keep his exact face, wavy brown hair, full beard, build, grey sleeveless hoodie and red work gloves (same person, do not beautify or change his age).
prefijo_ramon: Create a YouTube thumbnail, 16:9 landscape, everything important in the central area. Attached image 1 is the man: keep his exact face, wavy brown hair, full beard, build and grey sleeveless hoodie (same person, do not beautify or change his age).
sufijo: STYLE: like a top YouTube thumbnail: one huge hero prop that tells the story, simple composition, bright saturated daylight colors, clean uncluttered background, everything razor sharp. His face clearly visible, about 30 % of the frame height, well lit, looking straight into the lens, calm wide-eyed deadpan, mouth closed. Photorealistic, like a real photo, not an illustration, no plastic AI skin. No text, no logos, no watermarks, nothing in the bottom-right corner.

conceptos.titulo: A · Me Di 1 Hora para Decorar un Estanque Entero
conceptos.idea: Reloj de arena más alto que él, casi sin arena, en el borde; él dentro del estanque abrazando una montaña de plantas
conceptos.escena: SCENE: low camera at water level. On the left third, a giant antique hourglass taller than him stands on the brick edge of a garden pond, the top bulb almost empty, the last grains falling. He stands knee-deep in the pond on the right, hugging a huge armful of reeds and elephant-ear plants with dripping roots. White picket fence and palm trees behind.

conceptos.titulo: A · Me Di 1 Hora para Decorar un Estanque Entero
conceptos.idea: Despertador rojo gigante sonando en primer plano; él detrás plantando a toda prisa en un estanque medio vacío
conceptos.escena: SCENE: in the foreground, a giant red vintage twin-bell alarm clock, as tall as his torso, rings on the brick edge of a garden pond, shaking. Behind it he kneels in the half-empty pond pushing a plant into the mud with both hands, the other half of the pond already lush. He looks into the lens over the clock.

conceptos.titulo: B · Intenté Salvar Plantas de una Tierra de Cemento
conceptos.idea: Pala doblada en ángulo recto clavada en tierra agrietada como cemento; él con martillo neumático liberando una planta
conceptos.escena: SCENE: rock-hard cracked grey ground like concrete. In the foreground a garden spade bent at a right angle sticks out of it. He kneels behind with a yellow jackhammer pressed to the ground next to a reed plant whose roots are trapped in the hard earth, chips flying, safety goggles pushed up on his forehead. White picket fence behind.

conceptos.titulo: B · Intenté Salvar Plantas de una Tierra de Cemento
conceptos.idea: El perro sentado junto a un hoyo perfecto en la tierra dura; él con la pala partida en dos
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is his dog: keep the exact same big white dog. SCENE: rock-hard cracked grey ground. The big white dog sits proudly next to a deep, perfectly round hole it has just dug, earth on its front paws. He stands on the other side holding a spade snapped in two, one half in each hand, a small plant with roots waiting at his feet.

conceptos.titulo: C · Mi Perro Gigante No Me Deja Plantar el Estanque
conceptos.idea: El perro corre hacia cámara con una maceta entera en la boca; él detrás persiguiéndolo
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is his dog: keep the exact same big white dog. SCENE: the big white dog runs straight at the camera, big and sharp in the foreground, carrying a whole terracotta pot with a pond plant in its mouth, soil and water flying. Behind it, by the garden pond, he chases with both arms out, mouth open in a shout (the only exception to the closed mouth).

conceptos.titulo: C · Mi Perro Gigante No Me Deja Plantar el Estanque
conceptos.idea: El perro tumbado a gusto encima de la carretilla llena de plantas; él empujándola agotado
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is his dog: keep the exact same big white dog. SCENE: he pushes a green wheelbarrow overflowing with pond plants toward the camera; the big white dog lies relaxed on top of the plants like a king, eyes half closed. He looks into the lens, exhausted. Garden pond and white fence behind.

conceptos.titulo: D · Un Pájaro Salvaje Estrenó Mi Estanque Nuevo
conceptos.idea: Inauguración: una cinta roja cortada sobre el estanque con el pajarito posado en ella; él con unas tijeras doradas gigantes
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is the bird: keep the exact same tiny species and plumage (yellow crown stripe with black edges, white wing bars). SCENE: an opening ceremony: a red satin ribbon with a bow stretched across a freshly planted garden pond, just cut in the middle; the tiny bird perches on the cut end of the ribbon in the foreground, big and razor sharp. He stands behind holding giant golden ceremonial scissors, looking into the lens.

conceptos.titulo: T · Trasplanté un Estanque a Otro (recambio)
conceptos.idea: Un mismo estanque: mitad selva explosiva, mitad grava pelada; él en medio con una planta chorreando
conceptos.escena: SCENE: one garden pond seen from a low angle, one continuous scene with no dividing line: the left half explodes with lush reeds, elephant ears, yellow irises and water lilies; the right half is still bare gravel and still water. He kneels in the middle with a plant with dripping roots in his hands, held toward the lens.

conceptos.titulo: A · The "Easy" Pet Tortoise That Keeps Dying
conceptos.idea: Dos terrarios: uno empapado con la tortuga rusa dentro, otro seco; él limpiando el cristal empañado (especie corregida)
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is the tortoise, photographed under a yellow heat lamp: its real colors are an olive-brown, flat, round shell with dark brown blotches (Russian tortoise, Testudo horsfieldii); do not make it yellow or green. SCENE: two glass terrariums side by side in one shot: the left one soaking wet, foggy, water running down the glass, puddles, with the tortoise inside looking miserable; the right one bright and dry with sand and stones. He wipes the foggy glass with a cloth in his purple nitrile glove. Plain light background.

conceptos.titulo: B · Africa's Most Endangered Tortoise Fits in One Hand
conceptos.idea: La tortuga egipcia en un cojín de terciopelo rojo diminuto sobre su palma, como una joya, con foco
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is the tortoise: keep the exact same species (Egyptian tortoise, Testudo kleinmanni), pale sandy-yellow shell with dark edges, and its tiny size. SCENE: he holds his open palm toward the lens; on it, a tiny red velvet jewelry cushion with gold tassels, and on the cushion the tiny tortoise, lit by a bright spotlight like a precious diamond, sharp in the foreground. He wears one white cotton jeweler glove. Plain saturated blue background.

conceptos.titulo: B · Africa's Most Endangered Tortoise Fits in One Hand
conceptos.idea: Maletín esposado a su muñeca, abierto hacia cámara, con la tortuga en el terciopelo
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is the tortoise: keep the exact same species (Egyptian tortoise, Testudo kleinmanni), pale sandy-yellow shell with dark edges, and its tiny size. SCENE: close to the camera he holds open a black hard briefcase handcuffed to his wrist, tilted toward the lens; inside, on red velvet, the tiny tortoise sits like a treasure, the hero of the frame. He looks over the case into the lens, serious like a secret agent. Plain saturated blue background.

conceptos.titulo: B · Africa's Most Endangered Tortoise Fits in One Hand
conceptos.idea: Globo terráqueo con África de frente y la tortuga diminuta de pie sobre África
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is the tortoise: keep the exact same species (Egyptian tortoise, Testudo kleinmanni) and its tiny size. SCENE: he holds a big desk globe toward the lens with Africa facing the camera; the one tiny tortoise stands on top of Africa, sharp. Nothing else on the globe. He looks over the globe into the lens. Plain saturated blue background.

conceptos.titulo: C · There's an Amazon Rainforest Behind This Door
conceptos.idea: Abre una puerta corriente y revienta una selva con cascada; el lagarto caimán en el umbral (cara más grande)
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is the indoor jungle room with a waterfall and a lizard: the lizard is a caiman lizard (Dracaena guianensis), keep its exact species. SCENE: he stands close to the camera on the left, holding the handle of an ordinary white door he has just opened in a plain terracotta wall; through the door a dense rainforest bursts out on the right: a waterfall, mist, vines and leaves spilling over the doorstep, and the caiman lizard, large and sharp, on the threshold.

conceptos.titulo: D · Baby Snake-Necked Turtles Eat Like Piranhas
conceptos.idea: Frenesí de piraña: las crías de cuello de serpiente saltan con el cuello estirado hacia un grillo en sus pinzas
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is the baby turtle: keep the exact same species (snake-necked turtle, Chelodina siebenrocki), long neck and shell. SCENE: a black tub of water fills the bottom half: a dozen of these baby turtles strike upward like piranhas, necks fully stretched, water exploding in frozen splashes. He leans over the tub holding one cricket with tweezers just above them, looking into the lens.

conceptos.titulo: D · Baby Snake-Necked Turtles Eat Like Piranhas
conceptos.idea: Una cría de cuello de serpiente asomando el cuello por el borde de una taza de café, enorme en primer plano
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is the baby turtle: keep the exact same species (snake-necked turtle, Chelodina siebenrocki), long neck and shell. SCENE: a white coffee cup full of water on a wooden table, big in the foreground; the baby turtle hangs over the rim with its long neck stretched toward a cricket on the saucer. He sits right behind holding the cup handle. Plain saturated blue background.

conceptos.idea: Jardín inundado; la sulcata subida al tejado de su caseta; él en primer plano con chubasquero y paraguas (cara más grande)
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is the giant tortoise and its low concrete-block shelter: keep the exact same species (sulcata tortoise, Centrochelys sulcata). SCENE: the garden is flooded ankle-deep with brown water. Close to the camera on the left he stands in a yellow raincoat and yellow rain boots, holding a black umbrella. Behind him on the right, the giant tortoise sits dry on top of the roof of its flooded shelter.

conceptos.idea: La casa nueva sobre pilotes a medio hacer; él con el martillo y la sulcata mirándola desde abajo (cara y tortuga más grandes)
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is the giant tortoise: keep the exact same species (sulcata tortoise, Centrochelys sulcata). SCENE: a half-built tortoise house of concrete blocks raised on tall wooden stilts, a muddy puddle under it. The giant tortoise, big in the foreground, looks up at the house. He stands next to it close to the camera with a hammer, looking into the lens.
